Kazordoon is the dwarven city, inside the mountain The Big Old One, in the middle of the continent ({coord:32614,31923,7}). There are two ways to get there:
1. **{wiki:Steamship}**: from {wiki:Cormaya} (near Edron, with {npc:Gurbasch}) or from **Farmine** (with {npc:Thorgrin}), say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} and {key:yes}. You arrive at Kazordoon's underground port, next to {npc:Brodrosch}; from there go up into the city or use the {wiki:Ore Wagon|Ore Wagons} (250 gp licence sold by {npc:Lokur}).
2. **On foot**: through the mountain entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the route to the Kazordoon entrance}). Bring a {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel}: there are rope spots and hidden holes.
Go up to the throne room
{npc:Emperor Kruzak} is in the throne room, well above ground level (**4 floors up**, {coord:32626,31923,3}). Climb the city stairs up there.

Go to {npc:Emperor Kruzak}'s quarters, in **Kazordoon**, and enter his private bedroom, to the **north**. Follow the "secret passage" out to the **west** to the very end: there is a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} with the {item:Key 3800}.

**Do not** leave through the hole in the passage: go back to the emperor's room. Open the door of the small room in the bedroom with the {item:Key 3800}. In the chest inside there are 7 and 20 {item:Cookie|Cookies} (in a {item:Bag}) and the {item:Key 3801}.

There are two ways to the barracks:
1. **Faster**: go back to the barracks.
2. Go down several floors through the "secret passage" until you come out under Kazordoon (at ground level); from there you need a {item:Rope} to reach the barracks (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the route to the Kazordoon entrance}).
At the barracks, open the door with the {item:Key 3801}. In the {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} is the {item:Key 3802}.

The barracks are inside the city (1 floor above ground level): go down the stairs to the streets of Kazordoon. To leave the city, go back to the {wiki:Steamship} at {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of the city ({coord:32661,31957,15}), and say {key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine} and {key:yes}; or leave on foot through the mountain entrance, the same way you came in.
The {item:Key 3802} opens the prison of {wiki:Dwacatra} and a specific room in the {wiki:Dwarf Mines}, the {wiki:Mine Hub}.
